title: Cheonggukjang Umami Stew
description: A hearty, savory stew made with the rich flavor of Korean fermented soybean paste, cheonggukjang.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cheonggukjang and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the soy sauce and brown sugar, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with a mille feuille.
Optional: serve with rice or noodles for a filling meal.
